sample_method: 65536 equally spaced windows across concatenated LiME segment-contained all-byte candidate positions; no cryptographic candidate testing
interpretation: The full scan counts instances, not unique keys. Repeated keys always yield identical outcomes. Even treating every nonzero instance as a distinct independent random AES key, zero random suffix hits has approximately21% probability; duplicates increase this probability. The sample is descriptive and does not estimate the exact full-image unique count.
